description: Fetch the FULL research-report text behind a view (parsed long-form), for when the `views` summary is not enough. Only works on views where `full_text_available=true` (archived sell-side reports) — get those from `views --report-only`, do not guess a view_id. A 404 `no_full_text` means that one view is a plain opinion with no archived report; it does NOT mean the endpoint is unavailable or that no reports exist. Consumer pricing: 1 credit per PDF page, with no minimum or maximum document charge, per UTC day. Call format=quote first for free page_count and credit_cost; all subsequent outline/full reads share the same daily document charge. Unknown PDF page count blocks paid reads; unpaginated non-PDF documents cost 1. Two-step usage: default `format=outline` returns a few-KB heading map + total_chars + each heading's char_offset; then call `format=full` with `offset` (e.g. an outline char_offset) to read the body in pages — follow `next_offset` to page through large docs instead of pulling everything at once.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

format.description: quote=free page count and price; outline=heading map (default, charges document); full=body slice

max_chars.description: full mode: max chars per page (hard cap 80000)

offset.description: full mode: start char offset (use an outline char_offset)

name: report
